chain.label: FSOL lacked protection from external activation
chain.trigger: certification basis for the FSOL did not require protection from inadvertent activation due to external influences

chain.label: Liberty/NYONair safety management deficient
chain.trigger: Liberty's and NYONair's deficient safety management, which did not adequately mitigate foreseeable risks associated with the harness/tether system interfering with the floor-mounted controls and hindering passenger egress

chain.label: FAA inadequate oversight of Part 91 revenue operations
chain.trigger: the Federal Aviation Administration's inadequate oversight of Title 14 CFR Part 91 revenue passenger-carrying operations

chain.label: Tether tail caught on and activated FSOL
chain.trigger: the tail of the front passenger's tether caught on the fuel shutoff lever (FSOL), which resulted in the inadvertent activation of the FSOL, interruption of fuel flow to the engine

caused_by.evidence: certification basis did not require protection from inadvertent activation due to external influences
deficient safety management...did not adequately mitigate foreseeable risks...harness/tether system interfering with the floor-mounted controls
FAA's inadequate oversight of...Part 91 revenue passenger-carrying operations

chain.label: Loss of engine power
chain.trigger: the helicopter's engine sounds decreased, and the helicopter began to descend

caused_by.evidence: interruption of fuel flow to the engine, and loss of engine power

chain.label: Float system junction box installed off-spec
chain.trigger: the junction box...was installed...about 1.6 inches farther aft and about 0.25 inch higher than the location prescribed

chain.label: Activation handle not pulled fully aft; partial float inflation
chain.trigger: a force of about 45 lbs...was required before the left reservoir assembly activated...a force exceeding 58 lbs was needed to pull the activation handle fully aft to activate the right reservoir assembly

caused_by.evidence: the high forces required to pull the activation handle...led the pilot to mistakenly believe that he had successfully pulled the handle fully aft to fully inflate the floats

chain.label: Ditching and rapid capsize on East River
chain.trigger: he ditched the helicopter on the East River...the helicopter rolled right in the water and became fully inverted and submerged about 11 seconds after it touched down

caused_by.evidence: the helicopter was too low over the water to allow sufficient time to restart the engine
the floats inflated partially and asymmetrically

chain.label: Passengers drowned; pilot escaped with minor injuries
chain.trigger: none of the passengers were able to egress, and they all drowned

caused_by.evidence: the helicopter was completely inverted and submerged with only the floats visible above the surface
the NYONair-provided harness/tether system contributed to the passenger fatalities because it did not allow the passengers to quickly escape from the helicopter
